tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE GL_LEDGERS (
  LEDGER_ID NUMBER(15) PRIMARY KEY,
  LEDGER_NAME VARCHAR2(240) NOT NULL,
  LEDGER_CODE VARCHAR2(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  CURRENCY_CODE VARCHAR2(15) NOT NULL,
  COA_ID NUMBER(15) NOT NULL,
  LEDGER_TYPE VARCHAR2(30),
  PERIOD_SET_NAME VARCHAR2(30),
  STATUS VARCHAR2(30) DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  CREATED_BY NUMBER(15),
  CREATION_DATE TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  LAST_UPDATED_BY NUMBER(15),
  LAST_UPDATE_DATE TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT FK_GL_LEDGERS_COA FOREIGN KEY (COA_ID) REFERENCES GL_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS(COA_ID)
)

CREATE TABLE GL_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS (
  COA_ID NUMBER(15) PRIMARY KEY,
  COA_NAME VARCHAR2(240) NOT NULL,
  COA_CODE VARCHAR2(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  STRUCTURE_TYPE VARCHAR2(30),
  NUM_SEGMENTS NUMBER(2),
  DESCRIPTION VARCHAR2(1000),
  STATUS VARCHAR2(30) DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  CREATED_BY NUMBER(15),
  CREATION_DATE TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  LAST_UPDATED_BY NUMBER(15),
  LAST_UPDATE_DATE TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)

CREATE TABLE GL_ACCOUNTS (
  ACCOUNT_ID NUMBER(15) PRIMARY KEY,
  COA_ID NUMBER(15) NOT NULL,
  ACCOUNT_CODE VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
  ACCOUNT_NAME VARCHAR2(240) NOT NULL,
  ACCOUNT_TYPE VARCHAR2(30),
  NORMAL_BALANCE VARCHAR2(10),
  RECONCILIATION_FLAG VARCHAR2(1) DEFAULT 'N',
  ACCOUNT_STATUS VARCHAR2(30) DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  EFFECTIVE_START_DATE DATE,
  EFFECTIVE_END_DATE DATE,
  CREATED_BY NUMBER(15),
  CREATION_DATE TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  LAST_UPDATED_BY NUMBER(15),
  LAST_UPDATE_DATE TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT FK_GL_ACCOUNTS_COA FOREIGN KEY (COA_ID) REFERENCES GL_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS(COA_ID),
  CONSTRAINT UNQ_GL_ACCOUNTS_CODE UNIQUE (COA_ID, ACCOUNT_CODE)
)

CREATE TABLE GL_JOURNALS (
  JOURNAL_ID NUMBER(15) PRIMARY KEY,

CREATE TABLE GL_JOURNAL_LINES (
  JOURNAL_LINE_ID NUMBER(15) PRIMARY KEY,
  JOURNAL_ID NUMBER(15) NOT NULL,
  LINE_NUMBER NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  ACCOUNT_ID NUMBER(15) NOT NULL,
  DEBIT NUMBER(20,2) DEFAULT 0,
  CREDIT NUMBER(20,2) DEFAULT 0,

  PROJECT_ID NUMBER(15),

notes: All tables include standard audit columns (CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
Effective dating is implemented using START_DATE and END_DATE columns where applicable
Foreign key constraints are defined for referential integrity
Indexes are created on frequently queried columns and foreign keys
Primary keys use surrogate NUMBER(15) identifiers
Business keys (e.g., EMPLOYEE_NUMBER, PO_NUMBER) have unique constraints
Currency amounts use NUMBER(20,2) with 2 decimal places
Flags use VARCHAR2(1) with Y/N values
Status columns use VARCHAR2(30) with predefined values
CLOB data type is used for large text fields (descriptions, notes)
Multi-currency support via CURRENCY_CODE VARCHAR2(15) following ISO 4217
All module tables are prefixed with module code (e.g., GL_, HCM_, PAY_)
